mariyu athadu aavaranamu chesenu. Kudivaipuna, anagaa dakshina dikkuna nooru moorala podugu galaviyu peninasannanaaraviyunaina teralundenu.
vaati sthambhamulu iruvadhi vaati itthadi dimmalu iruvadhi. aa sthambhamula vankulunu vaati pende baddalunu vendivi.
utthara dikkuna nunna teralu nooru mooralavi; vaati sthambhamulu iruvadhi, vaati yitthadi dimmalu iruvadhi, aa sthambhamula vankulunu vaati pendebaddalunu vendivi.
padamati dikkuna teralu ebadhi mooralavi; vaati sthambhamulu padhi, vaati dimmalu padhi, aa sthambhamula vankulunu vaati pende baddalunu vendivi.
thoorpuvaipuna, anagaa udayapu dikkuna ebadhi mooralu;
dvaaramuyokka oka prakkanu teralu padunaidu mooralavi; vaati sthambhamulu moodu vaati dimmalu moodu.
atlu rendava prakkanu, anagaa iru prakkalanu aavarana dvaaramunaku padunaidu moorala teralu undenu; vaati sthambhamulu moodu vaati dimmalu moodu.
aavaranamu chuttununnadaani teralanniyu penina sannanaaravi.
sthambhamula dimmalu raagivi, sthambhamula vankulunu vaati pende baddalunu vendivi. Vaati bodelaku vendirekulu podigimpabadenu. aavaranapu sthambhamulanniyu vendi baddalathoo koorpa badenu.

aavarana dvaarapu tera neela dhoomra rakthavarnamulu galadhiyu penina sannanaarathoo cheyabadi nadhiyunaina butaapanidi. daani podugu iruvadhi mooralu; daani yetthu, anagaa vedalpu aavarana teralathoo sarigaa, ayidu mooralu.
vaati sthambhamulu naalugu, vaati itthadi dimmalu naalugu. Vaati vankulu vendivi.
vaati bodelaku vendireku podigimpa badenu, vaati pende baddalu vendivi, mandiramunakunu daani chuttununna aavaranamunakunu cheyabadina meku lanniyu itthadivi.
mandirapadaarthamula motthamu, anagaa saakshyapu mandira padaarthamula motthamu idhe. Itlu vaatini yaajakudaina aharonu kumaarudagu eethaamaaru leveeyulachetha moshe maatachoppuna lekka pettinchenu.
yoodhaa gotrikudaina hooru manumadunu ooru kumaarudunaina besalelu yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchinadanthayuchesenu.

daanu gotrikudunu aheesaamaaku kumaarudunaina aholeeyaabu athaniki thoodaiyundenu. Ithadu chekkuvaadunu vichitra mainapani kalpinchuvaadunu neela dhoomra rakthavarnamulathoonu sannanaarathoonu butaapani cheyuvaadunai yundenu.

parishuddhasthalavishayamaina pani anthatilonu pani koraku vyayaparachabadina bangaaramanthayu, anagaa prathishthimpa badina bangaaru parishuddhasthalapu thulamu choppuna noota padahaarumanugula aiduvandala muppadhi thulamulu.
samaaja mulo cherinavaari vendi parishuddhasthalapu thulamuchoppuna naaluguvandala manugula veyyinni aiduvandala debbadhiyaidu thulamulu.
ee pannu iruvadhi endlu modalu koni paipraayamu kaligi lekkalo cherina vaarandarilo, anagaa aarulakshala mooduvela aiduvandala ebadhi mandilo thalakokatiki arathulamu.
aa naaluguvandala vendi manu gulathoo parishuddhasthalamunaku dimmalu addateraku dimmalunu; anagaa oka dimmaku naalugu manugula choppuna naalugu vandala manugulaku nooru dimmalu pothapoyabadenu.
veyyinni aiduvandala debbadhi yaidu thulamula vendithoo athadu sthambhamulaku vankulanu chesi vaati bodelaku podiginchi vaatini pende baddalachetha kattenu.
mariyu prathishthimpabadina yitthadi renduvandala enubadhi manugula renduvela naaluguvandala thulamulu.
athadu daanithoo pratyakshapu gudaarapu dvaaramunaku dimmalanu itthadi vedikanu daaniki itthadi jalledanu vedika upakaranamulannitini
chuttununna aavaranamunaku dimmalanu aavaranadvaaramunaku dimmalanu aalayamunaku mekulannitini chuttununna'aavarana munaku mekulannitini chesenu.
yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchinattu parishuddhasthalamulo aharonu cheyu sevanimitthamu neela dhoomra rakthavarnamulugala sevaavastramulanu anagaa prathishthitha vastramulanu kuttiri.
mariyu athadu bangaaruthoonu neela dhoomra raktha varnamulugala nooluthoonu penina sannanaarathoonu ephodunu chesenu.
neela dhoomra rakthavarnamulugala nooluthoonu sannanaarathoonu chitrakaaruni panigaa neyutaku bangaarunu rekulugaa kotti adhi theegelugaa katthirinchiri.
daaniki koorchu bhujakhandamulanu chesiri, daani rendu anchulayandu avi koorpabadenu.

daanimeedanunna daani vichitramaina datti yekaandamai daanithoo samamaina pani galigi bangaaruthoonu neela dhoomra rakthavarnamulugala penina sannanaarathoonu cheyabadenu; atlu yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchenu.
mariyu bangaaru javalalo podigina lethapacchalanu siddha parachiri. Mudralu chekkabadunatlu ishraayeleeyula pellu vaatimeeda chekkabadenu.
avi ishraayeleeyulaku gnaapakaarthamaina ratnamulagunatlu ephodu bhujamulameeda vaatini unchenu. Atlu yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchenu.
mariyu athadu ephodupanivale bangaaruthoonu neela dhoomra rakthavarnamulugala pankthulathoonu sannanaara thoonu chitrakaarunipanigaa pathakamunu chesenu.
adhi chacchaukamugaa nundenu. aa pathakamunu madathagaa chesiri. adhi madavabadinadai jenedu podugu jenedu vedalpugaladhi.
vaaru daanilo naalugu pankthula ratnamulanu podigiri. Maanikya gomedhika marakathamulu gala pankthi modatidi;
padmaraaga neela sooryakaantha manulugala pankthi rendavadhi;
gaarutmathakamu yashmuraayi indraneelamunugala pankthi mooda vadhi;
rakthavarna puraayi sulimaaniraayi sooryakaanthamunu gala pankthi naalugavadhi; vaativaati pankthulalo avi bangaarujavalalo podigimpabadenu.
aa ratnamulu ishraayelee yula pella choppuna, pandrendu mudralavale chekkabadina vaari pella choppuna, pandrendu gotramula pellu okkokkadaanimeeda okkokka peru chekkabadenu.
mariyu vaaru aa pathakamunaku melimi bangaaruthoo allikapaniyaina golusulu chesiri.
vaaru rendu bangaaru javalu rendu bangaaru ungaramulunu chesi aa rendu ungaramulunu pathakapu rendu konalanu unchi
allabadina aa rendu bangaaru golusulanu pathakapu konalanunna rendu ungaramulalovesi
allabadina aa rendu golusula konalanu aa rendujavalaku thagilinchi ephodu bhuja khandamulameeda daani yeduta unchiri.
mariyu vaaru rendu bangaaru ungaramulanu chesi ephodu nedutanunna pathakapu lopali anchuna daani rendu konalaku vaatini vesiri.
mariyu rendu bangaaru ungaramulanu chesi ephodu vichitramaina nadikattunaku paigaa daani rendava koorpu noddhanunna daani yeduti prakkanu, ephodu rendu bhujakhandamulaku diguvanu vaatini vesiri.

aa patha kamu ephodu vichitramaina dattikipaigaa nundunatlunu adhi ephodu nundi vidipokundunatlunu aa pathakamunu daani ungaramulakunu ephodu ungaramulakunu neelisootra muthoo kattiri. Atlu yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchenu.
mariyu athadu ephodu cokkaayi kevalamu neeli nooluthoo allikapanigaa chesenu. aa cokkaayi madhya nunna randhramu kavacharandhramuvale undenu.
adhi chinugakundunatlu daani randhramunaku chuttu oka gotu undenu.
mariyu vaaru cokkaayi anchulameeda neela dhoomra rakthavarnamulugala penina nooluthoo daanimma pandlanu chesiri.
mariyu vaaru melimi bangaaruthoo gantalanu chesi aa daanimmapandla madhyanu, anagaa aa cokkaayi anchulameeda chuttununna daanimmapandla madhyanu aa gantalanu pettiri.
yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchinatlu sevacheyutaku okkokka gantanu okkokka daanimmapandunu aa cokkaayi anchulameeda chuttu unchiri.
mariyu yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchinatlu vaaru aharonukunu athani kumaarulakunu nethapaniyaina sanna naara cokkaayilanu sannanaara paagaanu andamaina
sannanaara kullaayilanu penina sannanaara laagulanu
neela dhoomra rakthavarnamulugala penina sannanaarathoo butaapaniyaina nadikattunu chesiri.
mariyu yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchinatlu vaaru melimi bangaaruthoo parishuddhakireeta bhooshanamu chesichekkina mudravale daanimeedayehovaa pari shuddhudu anu vraatha vraasiri.
yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchinatlu paagaaku meedugaa kattunatlu daaniki neeli sootramunu kattiri.
pratyakshapu gudaarapu mandiramu yokka pani yaavatthunu sampoorthi cheyabadenu. Yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchina prakaaramugaane ishraayeleeyulu chesiri.
appudu vaaru mandiramunu gudaaramunu daani upa karanamulannitini daani kolukulanu, palakalanu, kammulanu, sthambhamulanu, dimmalanu,
erupurangu vesina pottella thoolla paikappunu, samudravatsala thoolla paikappunu, kappu teranu,
saakshyapu mandasamunu daani motha karralanu, karunaapeethamunu,
ballanu, daani upakaranamulannitini, samukhapu rottelanu,
pavitra maina deepavrukshamunu, savarinchu daani pradeepamulanu, anagaa daani pradeepamula varusanu daani upakaranamulannitini deepamukoraku thailamunu
bangaaru vedikanu abhisheka thailamunu parimala dhoopa dravyamulanu shaalaadvaaramunaku teranu
itthadi balipeetamunu daanikundu itthadi jalledanu daani mothakarralanu daani upakaranamulannitini, gangaalamunu daani peetanu

aavaranapu teralu daani sthambhamulanu daani dimmalanu aavaranadvaaramunaku teranu daani traallanu daani mekulanu pratyakshapu gudaaramulo mandira sevakorakaina upakara namulannitini, parishuddhasthalamuloni
yaajaka sevaarthamaina vastramulanu, anagaa yaajakudaina aharonuku parishuddha vastramulanu athani kumaarulaku vastramulanu moshe yoddhaku theesikoni vachiri.
yehovaa mosheku aagnaa pinchinatlu ishraayelee yulu aa pani anthayu chesiri.
moshe aa pani anthayu chuchinappudu yehovaa aagnaapinchinatlu vaaru daanini chesiyundiri; aalaagunane chesiyundiri ganuka moshe vaarini deevinchenu.
mariyu yehovaa moshethoo itlanenu
modati nelalo modati dinamuna neevu pratyakshapu gudaarapu mandiramunu niluvabettavalenu.
acchata neevu saakshyapu mandasamunu nilipi aa mandasamunu adda terathoo kappavalenu.
neevu ballanu lopaliki techi daani meeda kramamugaa unchavalasinavaatini unchi deepavrukshamunu lopaliki techi daani pradeepamulanu veligimpavalenu.
saakshyapu mandasamu neduta dhoomamu veyu bangaaru vedikanu unchi mandiradvaaramunaku teranu thagi limpavalenu.
pratyakshapu gudaarapu mandiradvaaramu neduta dahana balipeetha munu unchavalenu;
pratyakshapu gudaaramunakunu balipeethamunakunu madhyanu gangaalamunu unchi daanilo neellu nimpavalenu.
teralachuttu aavaranamunu niluvabetti aavaranadvaaramuyokka teranu thagilimpa valenu.
mariyu neevu abhishekathailamunu theesikoni mandiramunakunu daaniloni samasthamunakunu abhishekamu chesi daanini daani upakaranamulannitini prathishthimpavalenu, appudu adhi parishuddhamagunu.
dahana balipeethamunaku abhishekamuchesi aa peethamunu prathishthimpavalenu, appudu aa peethamu athiparishuddha magunu.
aa gangaalamunaku daani peetaku abhishekamu chesi daani prathishthimpavalenu.
mariyu neevu aharonunu athani kumaarulanu pratyakshapu gudaaramu yokka dvaaramunoddhaku thoodukonivachi vaarini neellathoo snaanamu cheyinchi
aharonu naaku yaajakudagunatlu athaniki prathishthitha vastramulanu dharimpachesi athaniki abhishekamuchesi athani prathishthimpavalenu.
mariyu neevu athani kumaarulanu thoodukonivachi vaariki cokkaayilanu todiginchi
vaaru naaku yaajakulagutakai neevu vaari thandriki abhishekamu chesinatlu vaarikini abhishekamu cheyumu. Vaari abhishekamu tharatharamulaku vaariki nityamaina yaajakatva soochanagaa undunanenu.
moshe aa prakaaramu chesenu; yehovaa athaniki aagnaapinchina vaatinannitini chesenu, aalaagunane chesenu.
rendava samvatsaramuna modati nelalo modati dinamuna mandiramu niluvabettabadenu.
yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchinatlu moshe mandiramunu niluva betti daani dimmalanuvesi daani palakalanu niluvabetti daani pende baddalanu conipi daani sthambhamulanu niluvabetti
mandiramumeeda gudaaramunu parachi daani paini gudaarapu kappunu vesenu.
mariyu yehovaa mosheku aagnaa pinchinatlu athadu shaasanamulanu theesikoni mandasamulo unchi mandasamunaku mothakarralanu doorchi daanimeeda karunaapeethamu nunchenu.
mandiramuloniki mandasamunu techi kappu teranu vesi saakshyapu mandasamunu kappenu.
mariyu yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchinatlu athadu pratyakshapu gudaaramulo mandiramuyokka utthara dikkuna, addateraku velupala ballanu unchi
yehovaa sannidhini daanimeeda rottelanu kramamugaa unchenu.
mariyu yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchinatlu athadupratyakshapu gudaaramulo mandiramunaku dakshina dikkuna balla yeduta deepavrukshamunu unchi
yehovaa sanni dhini pradeepamulanu veliginchenu.
mariyu yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchinatlu athadu pratyakshapu gudaaramulo adda terayeduta bangaaru dhoopavedikanu unchi
daani meeda parimala dravyamulanu dhoopamu vesenu.
mariyu yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchinatlu athadu mandira dvaaramunaku teranu vesenu. Athadu pratyakshapu gudaarapu mandirapu dvaaramunoddha dahanabalipeetamunu unchi
daanimeeda dahanabali narpinchi naivedyamunu samarpinchenu.
mariyu yehovaa mosheku aagnaapinchinatlu athadu pratyakshapu gudaaramunakunu balipeethamunakunu madhya gangaala munu unchi prakshaalanakoraku daanilo neellu posenu.
daaniyoddha mosheyu aharonunu athani kumaarulunu thama chethulunu kaallunu kadugukoniri.
vaaru pratyakshapu gudaaramuloniki vellunappuduna balipeethamunaku sameepinchu nappudunu kadugukoniri.
mariyu athadu mandiramunakunu balipeethamunakunu chuttu aavaranamunu erparachi aavaranadvaarapu teranu vesenu. aalaaguna moshe pani sampoorthi chesenu.
appudu meghamu pratyakshapu gudaaramunu kammagaa yehovaa thejassu mandiramunu nimpenu.
aa meghamu mandiramumeeda niluchutachetha mandiramu yehovaa theja ssuthoo nindenu ganuka moshe pratyakshapu gudaaramuloniki vellalekundenu.
meghamu mandiramumeedanundi paiki vellunappudellanu ishraayeleeyulu prayaanamai poyiri.
idhe vaari prayaana paddhathi. aa meghamupaiki vellaniyedala adhi vellu dinamuvaraku vaaru prayaanamu cheyakundiri.
ishraayeleeyulandari kannula eduta pagativela yehovaa meghamu mandiramumeeda undenu. Raatrivela agni daanimeeda undenu. Vaari samastha prayaanamulalo eelaagunane jarigenu.
